sources: Microsoft Learn: 'SystemParametersInfoW function', SPI_SETMENUSHOWDELAY: delay in milliseconds before a submenu appears when the pointer rests on it. The Windows default is 400. The app sets the value through this function (takes effect immediately) instead of directly in the registry.
The description only promises the shorter delay, not a speed gain for programs.
